RELAXATION_PRESENT_VERIFIED.description: Official relaxation rule found with verified source evidence.
RELAXATION_PRESENT_VERIFIED.behavior: Apply exact relaxationYears to baseMax. Pass if age <= effectiveMax.

RELAXATION_NONE_VERIFIED.description: Official notification explicitly verified that NO relaxation applies.
RELAXATION_NONE_VERIFIED.behavior: Candidate exceeding baseMax is strictly disqualified (NOT_ELIGIBLE).

RELAXATION_UNRESOLVED.description: Relaxation clauses have not been audited or verified.
RELAXATION_UNRESOLVED.behavior: Candidate belonging to relaxable category (SC, ST, OBC, EWS, PwBD) exceeding baseMax yields UNRESOLVED / NOT_EVALUATED. Disqualification barred.
